check-spacing 2026-08-31 at a5f95c8, the first sweep against the RE-CAPTURED reference (Carbon react 1.115.0 / styles 1.114.0). 31 divergences across eight pages, down from 36, and 0 defects.

THE DROP IS NOT AN IMPROVEMENT AND MUST NOT BE READ AS ONE. The new spacing capture holds 777 signatures where the old held 798: 22 lost, 1 gained. Four of the five vanished divergences were the SAME adjudicated one -- stack-vertical.stack-scale-5 marginBlockStart on portal, table-page, empty-state and error-state -- and it vanished because cds--stack-vertical.cds--stack-scale-5 is no longer IN the reference. The fifth is stack-horizontal.stack-scale-6 on the sink, lost the same way. Nothing was fixed; the ruler got shorter.

CAUSE, and it is the tool not Carbon. The spacing harvest settles on `lines.length > 1`, which for a DOM tree means "has it painted" but for spacing means "has it produced more than one record". A story with exactly one spacing-relevant signature can never satisfy it, so it times out as (empty) and its signatures are lost. The 2026-08-31 run reported 59 empties and recovered 0 of 59 on retry -- slow-painting stories recover, genuinely sparse ones cannot. The header describes this exact flaw for icons and special-cases it; spacing has the same flaw and no special case.

WHAT WAS LOST INCLUDES THINGS WE SHIP: btn--primary at xs, md, xl and 2xl, btn--danger--ghost, btn--danger--tertiary, btn-set--stacked, stack-scale-5, stack-scale-6, badge-indicator and inline-notification--warning. Those elements now land in noReference (146 to 153 on the sink) rather than being compared. Reported here rather than papered over, and NOT fixed by merging the old file into the new -- that would mix 1.113-era and 1.115-era data in one reference and recreate exactly the provenance fault the _meta stamp was added to end.

_portal: portal.html RENDERS THIS FILE, so recording a reading against it changes the page the reading was taken from. Readings are taken on the build immediately before the entry is written; chasing the fixed point would not terminate, and what differs between the two builds is table text, altering no rule the three gates apply. KNOWN GAP: portal.html is a pageTarget of those gates but is NOT in their `inputs`, so editing it does not age its own cells. That is deliberate and it is a compromise. `inputs` is per GATE, not per cell -- kitchen-sink.html already ages the templates' cells -- so adding a page regenerated on every verify would mark every browser cell stale on every build, including cells it has nothing to do with. The narrower fix is per-cell inputs, which is a redesign of the registry and a separate decision.
